B_UI_CLOSE_ONLY_BLOCKS_NEW_ENTRIES (:96) offers only a BUY and asserts it is blocked. No reduce/close SELL fill is offered, so "reductions/closes still follow the leader", increases, and "applied to the entry component before netting" are unasserted.

B_UNKNOWN_MODE_FAILS_CLOSED (:105) asserts only bad-mode rejection (400 BAD_MODE) and that wallet_gate.json is byte-identical afterwards. Bad address, BAD_COPY_MODE, non-numeric/negative clamping, and UI error display are never exercised.

B_USER_WALLET_NEVER_ENABLES (:113) asserts set-wallet-mode ON for USER_WALLET returns 200 with gate mode still OFF. The "cannot be purged" clause is never exercised - no purge/removal attempt is made.

Line 74 asserts wallets_without_feed == 2, a health-metric COUNT of wallets lacking a WS subscription. It never asserts poll coverage, freshness, or that a mismatched wallet is blocked from being live.

C2-C6 (:77-89) assert both resting entry limits are cancelled on stop, the failed one is retained with its cloid+withdraw_pending and audited - i.e. zero unresolved submissions or explicitly reported. No order can be sent during stop because requests.post is stubbed to raise, so send-suppression is structural rather than asserted.

B2/C2/D2 (:231-242) assert restart reloads the unresolved reservation as blocking and that a crash-before/after-oid resolves from per-DEX MASTER evidence WITHOUT any resend - recovery from external truth with zero new authority.

Replays 300 fills through a live process and asserts exactly-one-terminal-row-per-fill, no re-queue on re-read, and cursor discipline. There is no crash, no restart and no non-sending recovery step, so "recovers only into a non-sending or explicitly safe state; operator action needed to resume" is untouched.

Neither asserts per-wallet state, reconnect counts, or the >HL_LIVE_WS_STALE_MS(30000) STALE/DEGRADED flag - the row itself marks that assert NO_TEST_YET.
